issue_claim: Drop 不存在的 collection 返回 code=0 而非文档 code=4(CollectionNotExists)
probe_what: POST collections/drop 删不存在的集合并记录返回 code, 声称应 code=4

issue_claim: entities/delete 静默接受互斥的 filter 与 ids 参数(应报校验错)
probe_what: entities/delete 同时传 filter='id>0' 与 ids=[1,2,3], 缺陷若 code=0 无校验错误
evidence: issue 与探针 probe_milvus_50323.py 均针对 entities/delete(delete 同时给 filter+ids): 探针 `http('POST', BASE + '/v2/vectordb/entities/delete', {...filter:'id > 0', ids:[1,2,3]})`; 但 stage2 endpoint 标签为 entities+insert, 与 issue 声称缺陷操作 delete 不一致

issue_claim: entities/insert 单次接受 101 个实体并返回 insertCount=101, 超文档 100 限制
probe_what: entities/insert 插入 101 实体, 报告 insertCount, 声称 100 限制未强制

issue_claim: 以下划线开头的 collection 命名被接受(code=0), 违反 [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]* 命名规则
probe_what: collections/create 用 _test_collection 创建, 测首字符下划线命名校验
evidence: issue 与探针 probe_milvus_50325.py 针对 collections/create 的名称校验 (探针 `_create('_test_collection', dimension=128, metricType='COSINE')` 即 POST collections/create); 但 stage2 endpoint 标签为 collections+list, 与 issue 声称缺陷操作 create 不一致

issue_claim: collections/create 接受越界 shardsNum 0/-1/65535 并返回 HTTP 200+code 200
probe_what: collections/create 依次传 shardsNum=0,-1,65535, 缺陷若 HTTP 200 且 code 200

issue_claim: collections/create 静默接受 metricType="" 与 consistencyLevel="None" 等非法参数
probe_what: collections/create 传 metricType='', consistencyLevel='None', dimension=32769, 缺陷若成功

issue_claim: entities/search 对 limit=0/-1 与维度不符返回 HTTP 200 而非 4xx
probe_what: entities/search 传 limit=0 及 64 维向量(dim=4 集合), 缺陷若错误只在 body 而 HTTP 200

issue_claim: users/create 不强制执行密码复杂度, 全小写 abcdefgh 被接受(缺 4 选 3 校验)
probe_what: users/create 测 abcdefgh(缺陷), ValidP@ss1(对照), 'a'(长度), 缺陷若复杂度未强制

issue_claim: upsert 在 autoID=true 集合上失败, 与文档声称 autoID 应自动生成主键矛盾
probe_what: 创建 autoID collection 后 upsert(不带 PK), 声称应自动生成 id 但失败 code=1100; 对照 insert 不带 PK 成功

issue_claim: collections/create 静默把非法 consistencyLevel 枚举替换为默认 Bounded 而不拒绝
probe_what: collections/create 传 consistencyLevel='Invalid', 缺陷若 code 0 后静默成 Bounded; describe 复验

issue_claim: collections/create 静默把非法 vectorFieldType 枚举替换为默认 FloatVector 而不拒绝
probe_what: collections/create 传 vectorFieldType='InvalidVectorType', 缺陷若 code 0 静默成 FloatVector; describe 复验
evidence: issue 与探针 probe_milvus_51085.py 针对 collections/create (探针 `_create('audit5', ..., vectorFieldType='InvalidVectorType')` = POST collections/create); 但 stage2 endpoint 标签为 entities+insert, 与 issue 声称缺陷操作 create 不一致

issue_claim: entities/upsert 对 JSON 字段传纯字符串会覆盖合法 JSON, REST/gRPC 存储格式不一且 gRPC 读不回
probe_what: entities/upsert 对 JSON 字段写 bare 字符串 invalid_json, 缺陷若被接受并覆盖 JSON; gRPC get/upsert 复验

issue_claim: entities/insert 静默把字符串数值强转为 Int64 主键(gRPC 拒绝)
probe_what: entities/insert 传 id='123'(Int64 PK), 缺陷若被接受; query/gRPC insert 复验

issue_claim: entities/search 接受 group_size=0/-1 且不校验(gRPC 拒绝为 negative)
probe_what: entities/search groupParams groupByField=cat, groupSize=0 与 -1, 缺陷若被接受即应拒绝; gRPC 对照
evidence: issue 与探针 probe_milvus_52309.py 针对 entities/search (探针 `_search('test_gs', ..., groupParams={'groupByField':'cat','groupSize':0})` = POST entities/search); 但 stage2 endpoint 标签为 entities+insert, 与 issue 声称缺陷操作 search 不一致

issue_claim: entities/insert 静默强转标量类型 string→Int64/int→VarChar/string→Bool 等
probe_what: entities/insert 传 string 123 进 INT64, int 123 进 VarChar, string true 进 Bool, 缺陷若被接受

issue_claim: entities/search 静默接受 group_by_field=vector 字段并忽略分组(gRPC 拒 unsupported)
probe_what: entities/search groupParams groupByField='vector', 缺陷若被接受且分组被静默忽略; gRPC 对照

evidence: issue 与探针 probe_milvus_52312.py 针对 entities/upsert (探针 `_upsert('test_upsert_pk', [{'id':'100', ...}])` = POST entities/upsert); 但 stage2 endpoint 标签为 entities+insert, 与 issue 声称缺陷操作 upsert 不一致

issue_claim: entities/upsert 静默强转标量类型 string→DOUBLE/string→BOOL/int→BOOL/string→INT16
probe_what: entities/upsert 传 string 3.14159 进 DOUBLE, string/int 进 BOOL, string 42 进 INT16, 缺陷若被接受

issue_claim: entities/insert 接受字符串编码的向量值(gRPC 拒绝 should be float_vector)
probe_what: entities/insert 传 vector='[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]'(字符串), 缺陷若被接受并解析为 float vector; search/gRPC 复验
